title: Signed releases: owning distribution
summary: Drake owns how SI reaches you too. Each release has a SHA256SUMS signed with an Ed25519 alpha key (ff949504...f54a, published in KEYS), and install.sh pins the exact tag and key, checks the signature, then every hash. The key is an alpha key held in a TPM-bound vault on his build machine, to be replaced by a ceremony key before beta. I can walk you through verifying alpha-20261026.1 offline: key forms, signature, hashes, each with a negative control.
goal: Understand how an SI release proves which bytes it contains, and verify alpha-20261026.1's signature and hashes offline.
key_steps: Take the public key from the repository's KEYS, not from the download
Check that the PEM and the raw hex key are the same key
Verify the Ed25519 signature over SHA256SUMS
Check every file's sha256 against the signed list
Mark files you could not check as NOT_RUN
Install only from an explicit tag, never latest

example.code:
note pemkey: stdin is an Ed25519 public key in PEM (SubjectPublicKeyInfo) followed by the same key as one
note line of hex. Decode the base64, check the 12-byte Ed25519 prefix (RFC 8410, OID 1.3.101.112), print the
note 32 key bytes as hex and compare them with the hex line.
note exit 0 the two forms agree, 1 they differ, 2 malformed
text tbeg "-----BEGIN"
text tend "-----END"
text tder "DER bytes "
text tpfx "Ed25519 SubjectPublicKeyInfo prefix: ok\n"
text tkey "key from PEM  "
text thex "key from hex  "
text tsame "the two forms agree: "
text yes "yes\n"
text no "no\n"
text vbad "verdict MALFORMED\n"
text nl "\n"
global der uchar 64
global pfx uchar 12
note b: 0 state (0 before BEGIN, 1 body, 2 after END), 1 bits, 2 nbits, 3 der count, 4 bad, 5 hex start, 6 hex end
global b ulong 7
fn setpfx to void
put pfx 0 48
put pfx 1 42
put pfx 2 48
put pfx 3 5
put pfx 4 6
put pfx 5 3
put pfx 6 43
put pfx 7 101
put pfx 8 112
put pfx 9 3
put pfx 10 33
put pfx 11 0
end
fn b64 c uchar to ulong
note value of a base64 character, 64 for padding, 65 for anything else
if and ge c 65 le c 90
ret ulong sub c 65
end
if and ge c 97 le c 122
ret add ulong sub c 97 26
end
if and ge c 48 le c 57
ret add ulong sub c 48 52
end
if eq c 43
ret 62
end
if eq c 47
ret 63
end
if eq c 61
ret 64
end
ret 65
end
fn push v ulong to void
acc = or shl get b 1 6 v
nb = add get b 2 6
if ge nb 8
nb = sub nb 8
n = get b 3
if lt n len der
put der n uchar and shr acc nb 255
put b 3 add n 1
else
put b 4 1
end
end
put b 1 and acc 255
put b 2 nb
end
fn body a ulong e ulong to void
for i ulong sub e a
v = b64 get inb add a i
if eq v 65
put b 4 1
end
if lt v 64
push v
end
end
end
fn oneline a ulong e ulong to void
s = get b 0
if sameb tbeg 0 a len tbeg
put b 0 1
else
if sameb tend 0 a len tend
put b 0 2
else
if eq s 1
body a e
end
if eq s 2
if lt a e
if eq get b 6 0
put b 5 a
put b 6 e
end
end
end
end
end
end
fn hexc v uchar to uchar
if lt v 10
ret add v 48
end
ret add v 87
end
fn cmpkey to bool
note print the key bytes as hex and compare with the hex line
h = get b 5
same = eq sub get b 6 h 64
ot tkey
for i ulong 32
x = get der add i 12
c1 = hexc shr x 4
c2 = hexc and x 15
oc c1
oc c2
if same
if ne c1 get inb add h mul i 2
same = false
end
if ne c2 get inb add h add mul i 2 1
same = false
end
end
end
ot nl
ot thex
oi h get b 6
ot nl
ret same
end
fn prefixok to bool
for i ulong 12
if ne get der i get pfx i
ret false
end
end
ret true
end
fn main to int
setpfx
r = rdall
if lt r 0
ret 2
end
n = ulong r
a = ulong 0
for i ulong n
if eq get inb i 10
oneline a i
a = add i 1
end
end
if lt a n
oneline a n
end
ot tder
on get b 3
ot nl
ok = eq get b 4 0
if ne get b 3 44
ok = false
end
if ok
ok = prefixok
end
if not ok
ot vbad
f = flush
ret 2
end
ot tpfx
same = cmpkey
ot tsame
v = int 1
if same
v = 0
ot yes
else
ot no
end
f = flush
ret v
end

common_mistake: Checking hashes without the signature: whoever can swap the bundle can swap SHA256SUMS too. Verify the signature against a key from elsewhere. Installing from 'latest' breaks the link between a receipt and what users ran.

install.sh: tag, key and every check in order

evidence_note: Offline on a Linux arm64 host: Omega checked the key forms, Node crypto verified the signature (oracle), sha256sum matched the three repository files, each with a negative control. The bundle and aienos.om were not checked (release assets); a real install on a GB10 is NOT_RUN.
